thread:
carla-corp: Hey team — we're seeing intermittent 403s from /v1/rerank and sometimes the call succeeds but returns an empty scores array. This started ~2026-03-16 21:30 UTC. Using model_id `corp-ranker/v2`.
matt-support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a minimal curl and the response body you got? Also any request_id or trace header would help.
carla-corp: Yep, here's a scrubbed example (token redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****REDACTED****" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -H "X-Request-ID: 7f9b2c" \ 
  -d '{"model_id":"corp-ranker/v2","query":"find best match","candidates":["a","b","c"]}'
```
Response when it failed:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "model type mismatch or not allowed for rerank", "code": 403, "model_id": "corp-ranker/v2" }
```
And a success-ish response we saw earlier:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "scores": [] }
```
matt-support: Thanks. Filing an internal triage and escalating to eng. In the meantime, can you try passing the full model GUID if you have it? That sometimes avoids alias routing.
jess-eng: :eyes: I can reproduce with the sample above. On my end the router returns a 302/redirect to an embed model id `embed-corp/enc-v3` before the runtime validator rejects the request. Looks like the `corp-ranker/v2` alias was repointed to a non-rerank model during yesterday's alias sync job.
Log snippet from my repro run:
```
[router] trace=7f9b2c route_decision: alias->model 'embed-corp/enc-v3' (type=embedding)
[validator] request_check: expected type reranker, got embedding -> respond 403
```
sam-ml: That matches a bug I pushed in the alias reconciler script — a race where a collapsed alias table copied the wrong target for tenant-scoped aliases. The reconciler ran at 2026-03-16T20:58:12Z. We need to revert that mapping for the affected alias.
eva-ops: I'll stage a rollback for the alias mapping and add a temporary redirect rule to map `corp-ranker/v2` explicitly to the GUID for the reranker model. Deploying to staging now. @deploy-bot can you start a canary for alias-mapping rollback?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for alias-mapping-rollback at 1745560000. Monitoring: routing errors and 403 count streams enabled.
matt-support: For the customer: workaround is to use the explicit model GUID or temporarily route through our dedicated rerank endpoint if you have tenant access. Confirming with customer now.
carla-corp: I can try the GUID — we have the reference GUID `m-ranker-0a1b2c3d`. Trying... ok sending request... getting 200 and scores `[0.87, 0.12, 0.01]` — that works. Thanks.
jess-eng: Good. I've rolled back the bad alias mapping and pushed a redirect rule. Patch PR: #4128. Also adding a reconciler safety check to prevent alias->model-type mismatches and an alert when a rerank alias points to a non-rerank model.
sam-ml: Will add a unit test for tenant-scoped alias copy in the reconciler and a migration to reconcile any other affected tenants.
eva-ops: Patch merged to staging, canary looks good (no new 403 spikes). Rolling to prod in 10m.
matt-support: Noted customer impact — offering a small credit for the hours affected and adding this incident to the weekly support digest. Customer confirmed workaround and happy with timeline.
carla-corp: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep me posted on the postmortem / RCA.
jess-eng: Will write a short postmortem once reconciler tests and monitoring are in. Initial RCA: alias reconciler bug caused alias repoint to embedding model -> runtime validator rejects rerank requests -> 403 or empty scores when routing falls back to a path that returns no scores.
matt-support: Closing loop — workaround (model GUID) works, rollback applied, follow-up PRs for hardening in flight. I'll DM you the billing credit details, @carla-corp. :thumbsup:
carla-corp: Great, thanks all. :heart:
